youtube_description:
Our CEO Subutai Ahmad took the stage at Intel Corporation's ISV showcase at CES 2024. He shared a live demo of our AI platform, NuPIC, showcasing how Numenta and Intel are elevating CPUs for AI inference with unmatched efficiency and cost savings.

Learn more about NuPIC here: numenta.com/platform

Video by Intel Corporation. 
- - - - - 
Numenta is a leader in deploying large AI models on CPUs. Our AI platform, the Numenta Platform for Intelligent Computing (NuPIC), is designed to help businesses build and scale AI applications on CPUs with speed, scalability and security. Rooted in two decades of neuroscience research, by mapping our neuroscience-based advances to modern CPU architectures, we are redefining what’s possible in AI.
